jobs.title: Communications Consultant
jobs.description: Communications Consultant This job researches, analyzes, writes, designs and produces a variety of internal and external communication materials and publications. They may develop materials including communications strategies, website content, creative for ad campaigns, news releases, speeches and publications. This role provides proactive strategic communications advice and manages communications pieces for programs and activities.

jobs.title: Child Protection Worker
jobs.description: Child Protection Worker This job provides a range of protective, preventative, and supportive services to children and families using the Family Centered Case Management Model of practice. They focus on assessing child safety, strengthening family functioning, implementing intervention strategies, and coordinating culturally informed supports. This role requires the ability to build collaborative relationships with families, caregivers, First Nations and Métis partners, and community agencies to promote child well‑being and family stability.

jobs.title: Probation Officer Community Youth Worker
jobs.description: Probation Officer Community Youth Worker This job provides essential services to individuals sentenced under the Youth Criminal Justice Act and the Criminal Code. This role involves conducting intake, assessments, and case management, while delivering targeted programming to support rehabilitation and accountability. The role also serves youth and adults released under Judicial Interim Release (Bail) with Electronic Monitoring, offering supervision and support as they await court appearances. Additionally, the role includes managing standalone sentences such as community service, restitution, and fines, with a focus on risk reduction and positive community reintegration.

jobs.title: Senior Program Consultant This position in the Mental Health and Addictions Branch at the Ministry of Health provides high-level research, evaluation, analysis, and advisory support to senior and executive management across a wide range of complex, sector-related initiatives. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring policies, programs, projects, and evaluations that address both social and economic policy issues. The role will apply collaborative and consensus-building approaches, engaging public and stakeholder input to shape strategies, frameworks, models, and plans. Performance of this work draws on deep knowledge of relevant legislation, government operations, and policy principles, while leveraging technical expertise in analysis, research, evaluation, and financial or contract management to solve problems creatively and effectively.

jobs.title: Child and Caregiver Support Worker
jobs.description: Child and Caregiver Support Worker This job provides intake, assessment, and case management services to individuals, with a focus on reducing risk and connecting clients to appropriate supports, resources, and programming. The role maintains accurate records and client files while supporting the overall well‑being of children, youth, and families. The position may require travel, flexible evening and weekend hours, and the provision of transportation when necessary to support effective service delivery.

jobs.title: Director, South Region The Director, Career and Employment Services provides strategic leadership for provincial programs, services and workforce initiatives while leading integrated service delivery within an assigned region. They guide policy, program and service direction, steward financial and human resources, and work with branch leadership, employers and partners to strengthen workforce and labour market outcomes across Saskatchewan.

jobs.title: Equipment Operator
jobs.description: Equipment Operator This job may guide a crew of equipment operators and oversee daily activities related to program delivery within a designated highway area. The role involves operating and maintaining heavy-duty equipment used in road maintenance, including trucks, brooms, packers, oil distributors, loaders, graders, stripers, and cranes. It may provide on-site supervision by assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring work is completed safely and efficiently. The position may also require operating road equipment, directing traffic in challenging roadway conditions and severe weather, and travelling extensively throughout the province. A valid Class 1A driver’s license is required, and the role involves physically and mentally demanding work, including heavy lifting, climbing, and sustained physical labour.

jobs.title: Program Support Supervisor - Finance This supervisory job provides leadership and oversight to a team of administrative support, ensuring the efficient delivery of administrative services. Key responsibilities include supervising daily operations, preparing reports and statistics, managing data using software tools, maintaining records and standards, and advising on policies and procedures. The role applies effective human resource practices such as recruitment, onboarding, performance evaluation, training, and leave management. It also involves determining clerical needs, preparing job descriptions, and participating in staffing processes. This role also manages budget preparation, expenditure authorization, and fiscal forecasting, coordinates with other branches, ministries, and agencies. The role collaborates with other programs to assess and fulfill operational needs and refers requests to other areas when appropriate.

jobs.description: Air Quality Specialist This job delivers results‑based environmental protection programs throughout the province by supporting compliance and effective implementation at the site level.
